source_snapshot.procedure: Enter BMC Web, click `Power`, and verify it accesses `Server power operations`.
source_snapshot.criteria: The icon link should be workable.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES substitutes a GET of `/redfish/v1/Systems/system`; this reads PowerState but neither exercises the UI link nor isolates nearby destructive power controls.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION restores the browser path, strict navigation-only boundary, BMC/host identity and proof that power state did not change.

old_problem: The historical record established a safe navigation-only test but retained Pending for the exact build, selector, destination markers, account, destructive-control map and no-submit interlock.
disposition_reason: The source requires only that the Power icon navigate to Server power operations; it does not authorize any power action. Build-specific selectors, route markers, read-only role and control map are supplyable prerequisites. ED-08 requires real WebUI evidence, ED-18 preserves any actual OFF/ON coverage for separate authorized tests, ED-20 retains this narrow case, ED-35 rejects a Systems GET as link acceptance, and ED-38 requires confirmation and recovery because the destination is a host-wide destructive surface.
decision_basis: XLSX row 847, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2 and historical record were directly reviewed.
A stable semantic link activation and rendered destination prove the source; no power selection, submission, confirmation or Redfish Reset action is in scope.
A read-only PowerState snapshot is useful only to prove identity/no side effect and cannot substitute for UI navigation.
The risk comes from control proximity and selector error, so a verified navigation element, hard no-submit boundary and first-attempt evidence are mandatory.

test_case.test_name: Verify BMC Web Power icon navigation without invoking any server power operation
test_case.purpose: Prove the authenticated BMC Web `Power` navigation control is present and reaches the approved `Server power operations` view exactly once, while every power/reset/cycle/NMI/graceful control remains unselected and unsubmitted and host power, reachability and event state remain unchanged.
required_package: Immutable BMC and host identity, trusted Web URL/certificate, firmware/UI build and corresponding host inventory
Supported browser/version and approved least-privilege/read-only account with protected credentials/session
Stable Power navigation accessible name/role/selector/location and approved Server power operations URL/SPA route/title/heading/DOM landmark
Inventory of every power/reset/cycle/NMI/graceful control, default selection, form boundaries, confirmation dialogs and action endpoints
Current host power/reachability/workload observer, BMC/host power-event baseline and optional vendor-approved read-only PowerState resource
Hard no-submit interlock, exact selector verification, timeout/SPA-idle rule, evidence redaction, abort rule and independent OOB recovery
test_case.test_command: Bind the browser to the exact BMC/host/build/account, capture host power/reachability and event baselines, and inspect the DOM without activation to distinguish the Power navigation link from every power-operation element and form. Verify the semantic selector, element type and target; do not use approximate coordinates. After explicit approval, activate only that navigation element once, capture route/redirect/network transition and wait for the approved rendered Server power operations landmark. Assert that no operation option is selected, no confirmation dialog or action request/form submission occurs, and host power/reachability/event state remains unchanged; an approved read-only PowerState check may support this assertion. Close the session without focusing, selecting or submitting operations. Do not clear logs or retry a failed/misdirected click.
test_case.expected_result: One activation of the verified Power navigation link reaches the expected Server power operations route/view and completes rendering without error. Every power action remains in its initial unselected/unsubmitted state, no action endpoint or confirmation is invoked, and host power, reachability and relevant BMC/host events show no transition. Optional read-only PowerState evidence agrees with the unchanged baseline but is not the primary link result.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires BMC/host identity binding, pre-click semantic separation of navigation from destructive controls, one real browser activation, correct rendered destination, no action selection/dialog/request and independently observed no-change state, with engineer review. A Systems JSON GET, icon presence, page URL, HTTP 200 or a rendered page without no-action proof cannot pass alone. Any wrong/multiple click, selected operation, confirmation/action request, power/reachability/event transition, wrong route or rendering failure is FAIL and triggers abort. Missing selector/control map/interlock/account/recovery is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS.
safety_gate: This test is navigation-only: never select, keyboard-activate, submit, confirm or invoke power on/off/reset/cycle/NMI/graceful operations or a Redfish Reset action.
Use a verified semantic selector and element target; approximate screen coordinates or tab-key traversal near action controls are prohibited.
Confirm BMC/host identity, current state, observer and OOB recovery before the click because a wrong element has host-wide blast radius.
Do not use `/redfish/v1/Systems/system` as proof the link works; approved read-only state is supplemental only.
Protect credentials/cookies and validate TLS; no `-k`, visible basic-auth command or full unredacted Systems response.
Never clear power/event/system logs; preserve them to detect unintended actions.
Do not retry. If any dialog opens, selection changes, action endpoint is requested or power/reachability changes, stop and do not attempt an unapproved recovery action.
expected_evidence: BMC/host identity, certificate, firmware/UI build, browser/version and redacted account/role
Pre-click DOM showing the semantic Power navigation selector/target separately from every destructive control and default selection
Single activation timestamp, route/redirect/network chain and rendered Server power operations title/heading/landmark
Proof no action form/URI, confirmation, keyboard activation or changed selection occurred
Before/after host power, reachability and BMC/host event evidence; optional trusted read-only PowerState snapshot
Redacted screenshot/DOM/console evidence, abort/recovery status and authorized engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: If an operation is selected/invoked or host state changes, stop all UI activity, record the exact element/request/time and preserve BMC/host logs. The authorized owner uses the pre-approved OOB and workload-aware recovery procedure to assess or restore service; the reviewer must not issue another power action. Reconcile sessions and state before any separately approved retest.

source_conflict.reason: Power icon, Server power operations destination and workable-link criterion coherently define navigation; the hazardous page does not imply execution of an operation.

blocked.reason: The navigation/no-action boundary is explicit; build/account/selector/control map/interlock and recovery are supplyable prerequisites.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: BMC/UI build, read-only role, exact navigation selector/destination, destructive-control map, state observer, no-submit interlock, abort and OOB recovery.

project_authority: Version-matched Project/vendor BMC Web navigation and power-control authorization specifications define the selector, destination and control boundaries. Actual power operations remain separate explicitly authorized tests.
